Marine refers to things found in or produced by the sea. (समुद्री)
Renovate (नवीनीकरण करना) means to restore (something old, especially a building) to a good state of repair.
Orchestra (वादक समूह) is a group of instrumentalists, especially one combining string, woodwind, brass, and percussion sections.
A lamb is a young sheep. (मेमना - भेड़ का बच्चा)
Plagiarise (साहित्यिक चोरी) means to take the work or an idea of someone else and pass it off as one's own.
Laundry is a place where clothes are laundered. (धोबीघर)
Recluse (वैरागी) is a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people.
Numismatics (मुद्राशास्त्र) is the study or collection of coins, paper money, and medals.
A lease is a contract by which one party conveys land or property to another for a specified time. (पट्टा/किराये का अनुबंध)
To misappropriate is to dishonestly or unfairly take something for one's own use. (गबन करना)
